- The changes in **TestSubWorkflowActionExecutor.java** ensure that the new configuration behavior is validated through tests, confirming that the sub-workflow inherits and correctly overrides properties as intended.
- Together, these changes enhance the configuration handling of sub-workflows in Oozie, ensuring that they respect parent properties while also allowing for their own specific configurations.

The changes across these files work together to address the bug OOZIE-2649 which prevented sub-workflow configuration properties from overriding those defined in the parent workflow. 

- In **SubWorkflowActionExecutor.java**, the order of configuration injection was altered to allow the sub-workflow properties to take precedence, thus ensuring that if the properties are defined in both the parent and sub-workflow, the sub-workflow properties are applied.

- The **TestSubWorkflowActionExecutor.java** file includes enhanced test cases that confirm the functionality of the new logic; it validates that configurations are correctly read and that sub-workflow properties can override parent properties as expected.
